experimental_design: To identify the unknown enzyme(s) involved in the desaturation of SDO to STO, enrichment was performed from soluble cell-free extracts of S. denitrificans grown on stigmasterol and nitrate.
factor_value: S. denitrificans grown on stigmasterol and nitrate
number_of_samples: The enriched protein bands migrating at approximately 60 kDa were excised, digested with trypsin, and analyzed by electrospray ionization quadrupole time-of-flight mass spectrometry analysis.
